name: std::resetiosflags
intro: When used in an expression out << resetiosflags(mask) or in >> resetiosflags(mask), clears all format flags of the stream out or in as specified by the mask.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
mask

 -

 bitmask of the flags to clear

sections.title: Return value

examples.output:
Parsing "10 010" with std::oct gives: 8 8
Parsing "10 010" with std::dec gives: 10 10
Parsing "10 010" with autodetect gives: 10 8

summary: When used in an expression out << resetiosflags(mask) or in >> resetiosflags(mask), clears all format flags of the stream out or in as specified by the mask.
